core.title: Daisy Pull Backplate, RK International BP-383

text.description_html:
RK International BP-383, Floral Cabinet Pull Rosette

This cabinet rosette is a great way to add an extra little bit of elegance. The Daisy Pull Backplate will look great with the matching cabinet pull or with something more simple like a beaded cabinet pull. It can be used with almost any cabinet pull with a 3 inch center to center. This Floral Cabinet Pull Rosette is available in the 3 most popular finish choice for today's designers: Satin Nickel, Polished Brass, and Oil Rubbed Bronze. We love how the petals flow into one another, giving this rose a sense of movement.

Also Available Matching Daisy Cabinet Pull

Specifications and Features of the RK International BP-383 Daisy Backplate for 3 Inch Cabinet Pulls:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/8"
  • Width: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 3/16"

Sold Individually
